A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 20-page paper, including supplementary Sections 6–12. Extracted text and rendered pages match except for the first-page arXiv version/date stamp. The image-based appendix case studies also match.

before.justification: v1 reports original RS-EoT-7B benchmark results, distillation comparisons, training-stage ablations, attention analyses, and supplementary experiments, including Tables 1, 3–5.

after.justification: v2 retains these original benchmark results and analyses, including the supplementary VQA reconstruction ablation in Table 5.

M1.justification: Section 3 and supplementary Sections 6–9 retain the identical SocraticAgent procedure, SFT cold-start, two-stage grounding/VQA reinforcement learning, and reward functions.

E1.justification: Training sources and modalities in Table 2, evaluation datasets and tasks in Table 1, and supplementary test cases are identical. No dataset, domain, or task coverage changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in the main benchmark comparison, frontier-model distillation comparison, and ablations in Tables 1 and 3–5, including the supplementary standard free-form VQA comparator.

E3.justification: Evaluation metrics, five-answer sampling protocol, model configurations, training budgets, and experimental controls are unchanged in Section 4 and supplementary Sections 7–11.

E4.justification: The training-stage and VQA reconstruction ablations, attention analysis, training-dynamics plots, and qualitative case studies are identical, including Tables 4–5 and supplementary Figures 9–15.

E5.justification: Sampling descriptions and statistical reporting are unchanged. Neither version adds seed information, repeated-run uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted curves, and qualitative examples match. For example, RS-EoT-7B retains RSVQA Avg@5/Conv@5/Pass@5 scores of 75.16/78.29/92.51 in Table 1; supplementary Table 5 is also unchanged.

T1.justification: Equation 1 and the supplementary grounding and VQA reward definitions are identical. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about RS-EoT, SocraticAgent, progressive reinforcement learning, benchmark performance, and mitigation of the Glance Effect.

C2.justification: Interpretations of attention cycles, reward stability, and complementary training stages are unchanged. The supplementary discussion of dependence on reasoning-trigger prompts is also retained without revision.

D1.justification: System prompts, hyperparameters, hardware, training times, parsing rules, and implementation frameworks are identical. The code/data/model access statement and project link are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, research-positioning passages, and all 50 references are identical. No cited work or relationship to prior research changes.

P1.justification: The first-page margin stamp changes from arXiv:2511.22396v1 dated 27 Nov 2025 to v2 dated 8 Apr 2026. The title, authors, prose, terminology, and section structure are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: All figures, tables, captions, and page layouts are unchanged. Rendered pages 2–20 are pixel-identical; page 1 differs only in the marginal version/date text recorded under P1.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, evidence, reproducibility information, and presentation remain identical across the main paper and appendices. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp does not meaningfully improve or diminish the paper's quality.
